payload.blocks: Starting the Opus replacement planner for workflow-engine; any planner started before the pin can bind agy/Gemini again.
payload.headline: Pin planner heads to Claude Opus: run one config command (my session is refused config writes)

parts.cause: fgos config patch is refused for a confined head (config-write-confined), and session start has no provider flag, so the pin must come from an unconfined shell before I start the new planner.

options.does: Run: ! fgos config patch .fgos/runtime/tmp/planner-pin.yaml --reason "owner 2026-11-21: planner heads run Claude Opus"  (sets runner.personas.planner tier flagship, prefer claude/claude-herdr-bypass-bwrap, same as lead)
options.gain: Same pin shape as supervisor/lead; next wake starts the Opus planner
options.label: You run the patch

options.cost: Likely a repeat of this swap
options.does: I start the planner without the pin
options.harm: Capacity selection may pick Gemini again
options.label: Start planner now unpinned

parts.recommendation: Run the patch; answer this question when done and I start head:planner-workflow-engine on Opus to review the draft plan.

scope.allows: Supervisor starts one Opus planner for workflow-engine after the pin lands
scope.forbids: Changing any other persona pin or promoting the draft plan to ready

parts.what: Your 15:51 order: replace the workflow-engine planner (it ran on agy, Gemini 3.8 Flash) with an Opus planner and pin the planner persona like supervisor and lead. I stopped the Gemini planner; its draft plan 261121-1314-coding-bugfix-guide was already landed (fd34767f0), nothing lost. Backlog p-of5vpvce3e now names planners (f7d31507a).
